chunks: Hadith 3200 — From the narration of Yusuf al-Kunasi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
"When you wish to bid him farewell, then say:

Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. We entrust you to Allah, and we convey peace upon you. We believe in Allah, in the Messenger, and in what he brought and what he guided to.
“And we followed the Messenger.” O Lord, “so write us among the witnesses.”

O Allah, do not make this the last covenant between us and him. O Allah, we ask You to let us benefit through his love. O Allah, raise him to a praised station by which You support Your religion, kill Your enemy, and destroy those who have set up war against the family of Muhammad, for You have promised him that, and You are—
“One who does not fail the promise.”

Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. I bear witness that you are noble martyrs; you strove in the way of Allah and were killed upon the path of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and the son of His Messenger, much. Praise belongs to Allah, who fulfilled His promise to you and showed you what you love. May Allah bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, and upon them be peace and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. O Allah, do not occupy me in the world away from gratitude for Your blessing, nor with abundance therein such that the wonders of its delight distract me and its adornment tempt me, nor with scarcity whose harm injures my deeds and fills my breast with its worry. Grant me from that a sufficiency from the evil ones among Your creation and provision by which I may attain Your pleasure, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

And I have presented in the Book of Ziyarat, and in the Book of the Maqtal of al-Husayn عليه السلام, various forms of ziyarat, and I chose this one for this book because in my view it is the soundest of the ziyarat by way of transmission, and in it there is sufficiency and adequacy.

key_terms.تُوَدِّعَهُ: to bid him farewell at the conclusion of the ziyarat
key_terms.رِضَاكَ: Your pleasure, the ultimate spiritual goal
key_terms.شُهَدَاءُ: martyrs who were killed in the path of Allah
key_terms.مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا: a praised station of honor and divine support
key_terms.نَسْتَوْدِعُكَ: we entrust you to Allah in parting

ai.seo_question: What farewell supplication is narrated from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام for ziyarat?
ai.summary: This narration teaches a farewell supplication to be recited during ziyarat, expressing salam, faith, loyalty to the Messenger, and a plea not to make the visit the last. It also affirms the rank of the martyrs of the Ahl al-Bayt and concludes with a du'a for gratitude, balance in worldly provision, and attainment of Allah’s pleasure.
